_comment: Copy to tags.json (git-ignored) and make it yours. Tags carry what folders can't: a file lives in ONE folder but can be proof of address AND in a tax year AND waiting on a reply. One colour per facet, so the dot alone tells you what kind of tag it is. Colours: none grey green purple blue yellow red orange. A tag can be referred to without its leading emoji.

tags.name: 🔥 Action needed
tags.description: Something to do: reply, pay, sign, send.

tags.name: ⏳ Waiting on them
tags.description: Sent or claimed; waiting for a reply, refund or decision.

tags.name: 📅 Renews or expires
tags.description: Has a renewal or expiry date worth watching.

tags.name: 📊 Tax 2025-26
tags.description: Belongs to the 6 Apr 2025 – 5 Apr 2026 tax year.

tags.name: 🎯 Career evidence
tags.description: Wins, reviews and certificates for a CV or promotion case.
